**Does this fit the project's current scope?**

cancellai is deliberately a single-file, stdlib-only, macOS-only tool for
Codex CLI + Claude Code session cleanup (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)
for the reasoning). A request that needs a new runtime dependency, targets
another platform, or targets another AI tool is still welcome, but say so
up front — it changes the discussion.
